project.name: has-permission
project.description:
This project provides a robust permission-checking mechanism for Java applications using Spring AOP (Aspect-Oriented Programming). It includes a customizable annotation (`@HasPermission`) that can be applied to methods or classes to enforce permission-based access control. The permission-checking logic is dynamically evaluated using SpEL (Spring Expression Language), allowing for flexible and context-aware permission resolution.
Key Features: - **Annotation-Driven Permissions**: Use the `@HasPermission` annotation to specify permission requirements at the method or class level. - **Dynamic Permission Resolution**: Supports SpEL expressions for dynamic subject resolution and permission evaluation. - **Integration with Permission Services**: Works seamlessly with any `PermissionService` implementation to retrieve permissions for a given subject. - **Aspect-Oriented Design**: Leverages Spring AOP to intercept method calls and perform permission checks before execution. - **Customizable Exception Handling**: Throws `PermissionDeniedException` when access is denied, providing clear and actionable error messages.
This project is ideal for applications that require fine-grained access control and dynamic permission management, such as enterprise systems, APIs, and web applications.
